//: Named chain registry — deploy.js and index.js loop over this instead of hardcoding chainA/chainB, so adding a 3rd/4th chain (or pointing an existing name at a real testnet) never requires touching relayer code, only this file + .env. Each entry's rpcEnv/deployerKeyEnv name the .env vars that override its defaults — see .env.example.

chainA.//: Gets a LightClientVerifier too (bidirectional relay — see PLAN.md Milestone 3's 'known limitation' note, since fixed) so it can accept remote-attested state from chainB, same as chainB accepts state from chainA below. Both chains being symmetric is what makes relayChannelState/watch.ts's fromChain/toChain params meaningful in either direction, not just A->B.

chainB.//: Gets a LightClientVerifier so it can accept remote-attested state from chainA.
